data.name: SWORD OF JUSTICE
data.detailed_description:
“Sword of Justice” is sparking a rebellion against outdated RPG builds! This groundbreaking Open World MMO defies tradition with stunning visuals and an immersive, lifelike atmosphere that deeply influences the game world. Step into "The Pulsing Martial World" and experience its breath-taking allure.

Premium Quality, Top-Tier Artistry

“Sword of Justice” is adapted from the classic literary masterpiece “The Four Great Constables: Sword of Justice” by Wen Ruian, one of the "Four Grandmasters of Chinese Martial Arts Literature." Combining pure Oriental classical aesthetics with modern chip graphics technology, it creates a unique and refined art style.It offers a solid single-player Open World RPG experience, blending the joy of inclusivity with a rich and layered sparring system.

No Grind, No P2W, Your Journey, Your Way

Sword of Justice introduces the groundbreaking "Paths Converge" system, where both competitive and casual players can earn full rewards through their preferred playstyles. The game abandons tedious grinding and shatters outdated MMO conventions, offering a stress-free experience. As the first season-based open-world MMO, the game offers hundreds of skills and pieces of equipment across its vast world for players to explore and acquire without paywalls.

Open World, Endless Possibilities

Players step into a vast open world, rich in Eastern aesthetics and the breathtaking scenery of the Song Dynasty. Roam the land, conquer peaks and caverns, and seek out lost weapons and martial techniques. Solve ancient puzzles and uncover wonders. Master martial arts to battle mythical beasts and outlaws across the wilderness, gathering rare treasures.

Beyond combat, Sword of Justice brings the bustling streets of the Song Dynasty to life. Players can perform, test their skill in archery, preside over court trials, and engage in nearly a hundred professions in a world inspired by Along the River During the Qingming Festival.

Unparalleled Competition, Challenge Accepted

The game breaks free from traditional class restrictions with a revolutionary martial arts system. Tanks can heal while healers can unleash powerful attacks. Players can combine hundreds of martial skills freely to create unique fighting styles—your game, your rules.

Epic Dungeons, Stunning Visuals

Rally legendary heroes for epic dungeons, and feast your eyes on unique weapons, stunning skill effects, and cinematic combat animations.

Solo Gamers' Haven, Relax and Play

Breaking away from traditional online games that force players into mandatory team-ups, the "NPC Companion System" enables solo players to tackle group dungeons, making gaming less stressful. “Sword of Justice” emphasizes the joy of diversity and values the experience of laid-back players. Its "casual light gameplay" is exceptionally rich, offering equal core rewards. Farming, fishing, chess, sightseeing, travel, and archaeology—activities often considered "offbeat" in traditional RPGs—take center stage in Sword of Justice.

Sword of Justice invites players to step into its pulsing martial world. Together, we'll forge a new era of MMORPGs.

Every encounter in the world is written by fate.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit or newer
  • Processor: Intel i5 9th generation or better (or AMD equivalent)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GTX750TI or better (or AMD equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 55 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: We recommend that you install the game on an SSD drive for a more streamlined experience.
